Make the bed: Start your morning with a small win.
Wipe down kitchen counters: Prevents grease and grime buildup.
Clean the dishes: Aim for an empty sink before bed.
15-minute "Clutter Sweep": Put away shoes, mail, and toys in common areas.
Take out the trash/recycling: Especially if it contains food waste.
Sanitize high-touch surfaces: Doorknobs, light switches, and phone screens.
